findings.effect: `extractWords` spreads `null` when text has no letters, causing a TypeError. Failed turns with empty assistant text crash `checkTranscript` instead of being recorded as `turn_error`, and user messages containing only digits or emoji also crash.

A single English stopword causes the language heuristic to discard all new Spanish content-word, accent and punctuation evidence. Because the English list includes words common in Spanish, such as `me`, short Spanish replies can pass when English is expected.
